name: External Validation Rule Identification 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external validation rule identification scheme name code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

CCTR.name: Crossborder Transactions Currency Control Reporting

ITRP.name: Invoice Tax Reporting
ITRP.definition: Identifies the validation rules related to the invoice tax reporting.

SMMD.name: Sterling Money Market Daily
SMMD.definition: Identifies the validation rules related to the Bank Of England Sterling Money Market Daily Reporting.
